data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'yalon', meaning 'stream' or 'river'. This name evokes images of flowing water and the power and renewal it represents. The name Yalonda carries the meaning “Beautiful river” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Yalonda usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful river and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yalonda has a rich cultural significance, particularly in the African American community. It pays homage to the Greek origin but also incorporates the importance of water in many African cultures. Water is often seen as a symbol of life, renewal, and purification in various African spiritual practices.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Yalonda encapsulates the believing Christian's connection with God through His divine miracles. The flowing water imagery can represent faith, which continues to move, progress, and evolve despite the challenges we may face in life. It can also symbolize the Living Water that Jesus offers in John 4:14 - "Whoever drinks from this water will thirst again, but whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will never thirst." Therefore, for any Christians named Yalonda, their name can serve as a constant reminder of the renewing and sustaining power of faith and God's love.
